name: Omnisearch (MCP)
description: 聚合搜索 MCP:28+ 源(学术/StackOverflow/GitHub/HackerNews/Wikipedia/HuggingFace/SearXNG)统一为 universal_search 工具(index 广播检索 / full 按 target_id 取全文),自带限流与去重。本地开发接线:指向 D:/myproject/omnisearch-mcp 的 venv,PyPI 发布后可切 uvx。

tools.name: universal_search
tools.description: 统一检索:index 模式向选定源并行广播(query 支持 site:/author:/since: 操作符,返回去重索引项+sources_used/failed);full 模式按 {source}_{id} 取全文(Markdown,带截断保护)

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: 多学术源聚合检索(arxiv/pubmed/crossref 等 25 源,返回逐源统计)

tools.name: search_stackoverflow
tools.description: StackOverflow 问题检索(score/answer_count/tags 元数据)

tools.name: search_github_issues
tools.description: GitHub Issues 检索(repo/state/labels 元数据)

tools.name: search_hackernews
tools.description: Hacker News 检索(points/评论数元数据)

tools.name: search_github_repos
tools.description: GitHub 仓库检索(stars/forks/language 元数据)

tools.name: search_wikipedia
tools.description: 维基百科检索(中英文,中文查询优先 zh;受限网络需代理)

tools.name: search_huggingface
tools.description: HuggingFace 模型/数据集检索(下载量/点赞元数据;受限网络需代理)
